exposure: abnormal findings in preoperative chest X-ray
preoperative estimated risk for postoperative mechanical ventilation
cohort: The study participants were 85 children undergoing primary scoliosis surgery at a university-affiliated general hospital between January 2010 and June 2020.
finding: Smaller bodyweight percentile, neuromuscular etiology, abnormal findings in preoperative chest X-ray, additional comorbidities, and preoperative estimated risk for postoperative mechanical ventilation were identified as risk factors for postoperative ICU stay.
